overview: The City Council approved an initial collective bargaining agreement and funding transfer for Teamsters Local 25, relocated the Ward 2, Precinct 1 polling place to the Roberts School, and passed a water bond loan order. The council also approved several non-union personnel classifications while referring others to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Teamsters Local 25 Compensation Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: The council waived three readings and approved Chapter 66 compensation plan amendments covering 12 employees under the newly negotiated first collective bargaining agreement with Teamsters Local 25.

items.title: Teamsters Local 25 Contract Funding Transfer
items.summary: Approved a transfer of $288,188.51 across multiple department personnel budgets to fund the retroactive settlement with Teamsters Local 25.

items.title: Zoning Board of Appeals Reorganization Hearing
items.summary: Continued to the next meeting a public hearing regarding an ordinance amendment to expand the Zoning Board of Appeals membership.

items.title: Citizens Bank ADA Sidewalk Upgrades
items.summary: Tabled a petition by Citizens Bank for an ADA ramp extending onto the public sidewalk on Spring Street pending guidance on licensing fees, maintenance conditions, and municipal liability.

items.title: High-Rise Building Inspection Protocol
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the building commissioner report the city's inspection protocols for buildings exceeding four stories.

items.title: Staff and Community Recognitions
items.summary: Approved resolutions congratulating retiring Medford High School teacher Andrew Milne, outgoing Finance Director and CFO Aleesha Nunley Benjamin, and student athlete Amy Orcutt.

items.title: Finance Department Operations Plan
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update from the administration regarding operational plans for the finance and auditing departments during the CFO vacancy.

items.title: Municipal Maintenance and Service Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting DPW maintenance at the former Hegner Center, a report on a credit card billing glitch from Park Medford, and a staffing update for the Planning, Development and Sustainability Department.

items.title: Ward 2, Precinct 1 Polling Place Relocation
items.summary: Approved relocating the Ward 2, Precinct 1 polling place to Roberts Elementary School following the sale of the St. Francis Parish Center.

items.title: Memorials and Recognitions
items.summary: Adopted condolence resolutions for Ray Buckland and Joseph Blasetti, congratulated Chromatic Tattoo on its 20th anniversary, and held a moment of silence for Brian Rabbit Day.

items.title: Cannabis Community Meeting Public Access
items.summary: Requested that notices for proposed cannabis establishment community meetings include remote access links and be published on the city events calendar.

items.title: Non-Union Personnel Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Approved on first reading several amendments creating and reclassifying non-union municipal positions, while referring the proposed Chief People Officer and nurse classifications to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Water Bond Loan Order
items.summary: Approved the loan order for water bonds upon its third reading.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved records for the meetings held on June 25, 2021, and June 29, 2021.
